title: The Truth Behind the 2003 'Windows 2000' Blue Screen Hack

scenes.text: In 2003 a viral video claimed a simple key combo crashed Windows 2000 for everyone.
The myth says pressing Ctrl + Alt + Delete repeatedly could force a system‑wide blue screen.
scenes.label: Ctrl+Alt+Delete crash
scenes.query: Ctrl Alt Delete blue screen myth

scenes.text: Windows 2000’s kernel required a privileged driver exploit to trigger a BSOD; ordinary key presses cannot cause a system‑wide crash.
scenes.label: Requires driver exploit
scenes.query2: how to cause blue screen Windows 2000

scenes.text: Key combos are safe – real crashes need deep system bugs.
scenes.label: Safe shortcuts
scenes.sub: Only low‑level code can force a blue screen.
